summary: Preserve installed committed Fabric cutovers when expiry capability cannot be established

compatibility.detail: Blocked preparation stops staging. Blocked committed rotations preserve both installed identities and expiry exactly, for either owner namespace.

manual.detail: Fabric v0.9.4 must still precede Fractal rekey deployment; expiry state still requires explicit migration before a v0.9.3 rollback.

recovery.detail: Capability failures cannot replay changes to committed identities, promote the expiring old identity, or revoke the permanent new identity. Unrelated policy operations continue.
